edges.reason: msg.sender drives per-wallet accounting and eligibility inside mint
msg.sender is hashed into the pseudo-random seed
block.timestamp is hashed into the pseudo-random seed, creating timestamp dependency
weak randomness depends on miner-influenced block.timestamp
randNonce is incremented and hashed into the randomness computation
msg.sender is part of the predictable randomness computation
randMod implements the weak randomness operation
randMod increments the randNonce state variable
mint calls randMod to select the hoodie for each iteration
_numHoodies controls the mint loop count and payment amount
_modulus is used in the modulo of the random hash
price multiplied by _numHoodies is compared to msg.value
totalRemaining1 is read and decremented during mint
totalRemaining2 is read and decremented during mint
totalRemaining3 is read and decremented during mint
totalClaimed per sender is checked and incremented to enforce MAX_PER_WALLET
saleIsActive must be true for mint to proceed
checkSaleEligiblity gates who is allowed to mint
tokenWhitelistInfo array is iterated to determine eligibility
addressEligible mapping is consulted as a fallback eligibility source
checkSaleEligiblity performs external balanceOf calls on whitelist tokens
whitelist token address is used as the external call target
mint calls _mintBatch to issue the selected hoodies
_mintBatch adds amounts into the _balances mapping
_mintBatch invokes the safe transfer acceptance check
acceptance check makes an external callback into the receiver contract
receiver callback returns control to the acceptance check, enabling reentrant execution
safeTransferFrom performs the acceptance callback after balance updates
safeBatchTransferFrom performs the acceptance callback after balance updates
mint transfers the sMNFST reward to msg.sender
sMNFST token address is the target of the external transfer
toggleSaleIsActive queries the sMNFST balance of the contract
toggleSaleIsActive flips the saleIsActive flag
totalRemaining1 feeds the required sMNFST balance computation
totalRemaining2 feeds the required sMNFST balance computation
totalRemaining3 feeds the required sMNFST balance computation
mintToTreasury calls _mintBatch for the treasury allocation
treasury address is the recipient of the treasury batch mint
treasuryHasMinted must be false for mintToTreasury to run
mintToTreasury sets treasuryHasMinted to true
treasuryHasMinted adjusts the treasury allocation in totalSupply
treasuryHasMinted adjusts the treasury allocation in totalHoodiesMinted
totalSupply for id 1 is derived from totalRemaining1
totalSupply for id 2 is derived from totalRemaining2
totalSupply for id 3 is derived from totalRemaining3
totalHoodiesMinted subtracts totalRemaining1 from the cap
totalHoodiesMinted subtracts totalRemaining2 from the cap
totalHoodiesMinted subtracts totalRemaining3 from the cap
totalClaimedBy reads the totalClaimed mapping
withdrawAllEth performs a full-balance low-level call to treasury
treasury address is the destination of the low-level value call
cached balance local variable is forwarded in the low-level call
withdrawAllsMNFST performs an external sMNFST transfer to treasury
sMNFST address is used for the withdrawal balance query and transfer
cached sMNFSTBalance local variable is transferred to treasury
saleIsActive blocks sMNFST withdrawal while the sale is running
_address parameter is inserted or updated in the whitelist
addWhitelistToken mutates the tokenWhitelistInfo array
addWhitelistAddress sets entries in the addressEligible mapping
inPrice parameter is assigned to the price state variable
setPrice updates the price state variable
_treasury parameter is assigned to the treasury state variable
setTreasury updates the treasury state variable
_owner is compared with msg.sender in the onlyOwner check of withdrawAllEth
onlyOwner restricts withdrawAllEth to the contract owner (msg.sender)
onlyOwner restricts mintToTreasury to the contract owner (msg.sender)
transferOwnership guards on _owner and reassigns it to newOwner
onlyOwner requires msg.sender to equal the stored owner
hoodieNum local variable drives the branch selecting which supply counter to decrement
totalClaimed accounting aggregates into the total minted computation
sale state influences whether ETH withdrawal path is reachable
sMNFST address is used in mint for the reward transfer
treasury is the beneficiary of the ETH withdrawal

normalization_plan.reason: mint parameter only meaningful within the mint flow, normalize into the mint function node
randMod parameter used solely by the weak randomness function, normalize into randMod
token address parameter used only by addWhitelistToken, normalize into that function
price parameter used only by setPrice, normalize into the setter function
treasury parameter used only by setTreasury, normalize into the setter function
random hoodie local is produced and consumed entirely inside mint, normalize into mint
cached ETH balance exists only to feed the low-level treasury call, normalize into that unsafe operation
cached sMNFST balance is only used to drive the withdrawal transfer, normalize into withdrawAllsMNFST
